support_claim: Commercial notes record that Oakfield Logistics GmbH, the MSA-OAK-2018 counterparty, rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH in 2023 while registration number HRB 88421 remained unchanged, establishing identity between the billed entity and the contract counterparty.
